# Handwriting AI API

> Create a handwritten JPEG, PNG, or PDF in one request. The response returns short-lived download links.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/): What the API returns.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/quickstart): First JPEG and first PDF.
- [Authentication](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/authentication): API keys and download links.
- [Render](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/renders): Images, PDFs, and the response fields.
- [Page setup](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/page-setup): Page size, paper, margins, and DPI.
- [Handwriting](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/handwriting): Fonts, ink, realism, and seed.
- [Fonts](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/fonts): font_id catalog.
- [Request and response](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/reference): Every field.
- [Limits](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/limits): Pages, characters, rate, and link lifetime.
- [Errors](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/errors): Status codes and error bodies.
- [Node.js client](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/sdk): The handwriting-ai package.

## OpenAPI

- [openapi.yaml](https://docs.handwriting-ai.com/openapi.yaml)

## Product

- [Handwriting AI](https://handwriting-ai.com)
